stories.title: Eight lorries ordered off the road in Flintshire police checks
stories.summary: Eight lorries were ordered off the road as unsafe during a day of police and safety checks on delivery vehicles around Flintshire and Deeside. stories.title: FOI data reveals scale of hot car dog incidents reported to North Wales Police since 2023
stories.summary: North Wales Police received more than 90 calls about dogs left in hot vehicles between 2023 and May 2026, including one in which a dog died, according to data released under the Freedom of Information Act. stories.title: The Deeside based firm putting Japanese street food snacks in every Tesco
stories.summary: A snack company based on Deeside Industrial Park has launched a seven-product range in Tesco stores across the country. Calbee UK is the European arm of Japanese manufacturer Calbee Inc. The range went on sale in Tesco from 20 May. stories.title: More than 230,000 people in Wales now living with diabetes
stories.summary: The number of people living with diabetes in Wales is rising faster than health officials had predicted. stories.title: Flintshire road casualties fall to decade low, official figures show
stories.summary: The number of people hurt on Flintshire’s roads has fallen to its lowest level in at least a decade, but the number killed or seriously injured has barely changed.
